required.name: uv
required.description: Runs the installer, and the tools of the profiles.

required.name: git
required.description: Clones the packages and records their revisions.

required.name: gh
required.description: The GitHub command line, for the pull requests and the checks of CI.

required.name: jlog
required.description: The shell of each recipe that just install writes. It logs each line in .agents/log, and it sets the PATH from the .jlog folders. Install the release binary with `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rahuldave/jlog/v0.5.0/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --tag v0.5.0`, which puts jlog in ~/.local/bin. To build it from source, git clone https://github.com/rahuldave/jlog, git checkout v0.5.0, then just install in the clone.
required.install: Run `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rahuldave/jlog/v0.5.0/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --tag v0.5.0`, then put ~/.local/bin on PATH. To build it from source instead, git clone https://github.com/rahuldave/jlog, run git checkout v0.5.0 in the clone, then run just install in the clone.

optional.name: jagt
optional.description: Renders and checks agentic Just packets for the jagt-protocol skill. The skill needs jagt 0.3.0 or later, which gives each packet a nonce.
optional.install: Run `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rahuldave/jagt/v0.6.4/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --tag v0.6.4`, then put ~/.local/bin on PATH. To build it from source instead, run `cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/rahuldave/jagt --tag v0.6.4 jagt`.

optional.name: cx
optional.description: Runs incremental file stages for the cx skill. The skill needs cx 0.1.0 or later. The check is cx --help, which prints the version on each build of 0.1.0; cx --version came later in 0.1.0.
optional.install: Run `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rahuldave/cx/v0.2.3/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --tag v0.2.3`, then put ~/.local/bin on PATH. To build it from source instead, run `cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/rahuldave/cx --tag v0.2.3 cx`.
